correctness.rationale: For one pass of independently cut in-place packet reversal from the identity, a packet of length l contributes 1_{l odd} fixed positions and l(l-1)/2 inversions. Turning a cut on increases F weakly and decreases I strictly; Harris product-measure inequality with a strictly influential cut proves unconditional Cov<0. Given M=m packets, all positive compositions are uniform: parity/stars-bars yields the precise F support and distribution; uniform weak-composition factorial moments give the increasing exact conditional regression and nonnegative covariance, strict exactly when 2+(n mod2)<=m<=n-2. The fixed-p multivariate renewal-reward CLT for geometric lengths yields the stated Sigma and correlation -(1+q^2)/(1+q)^2; terminal geometric residual is negligible and exponential moments justify covariance convergence. Independent enumeration all compositions for n=2..11 and multiple rational p corroborated finite formulas and signs. Reconstructed complete Git tree.
residual_risks: One in-place packet reversal from identity, not globally reversed physical deck, repeated shuffles, or dependent cuts.
The Gaussian covariance limit is for fixed 0<p<1; finite enumeration does not prove the CLT.
